title: Website builder or web designer: which do you need?
metaTitle: Website Builder vs Web Designer: Wix, Shopify or Custom? (2026)
description: Website makers like Wix, Squarespace and Shopify versus hiring a web designer: an honest comparison of cost, speed, SEO and ownership for businesses in India.
intro: An honest comparison of website makers and custom websites: cost, speed, SEO and who owns what.
facts: Monthly fee, a template, you rent it
One-time build, your design, you own it

sections.title: What a website builder is
body: A website builder, also called a website maker, is a subscription service such as Wix, Squarespace, Hostinger Website Builder or Shopify. You pick a template, drag in your content and publish. The platform hosts the site, and you pay every month or year for as long as it stays online.
A web designer builds a website for your business specifically: the structure, the design, the content and the code. You pay for the build once, then for hosting and any changes.

head: Website builder
Custom website
rows: Subscriptions, add-on apps and transaction fees add up
A template shared with many other sites
Designed for your business and your customers
Often heavy, with scripts you cannot remove
Built lean, fast on mobile networks
The basics, with limited control over structure
Full control: structure, speed, structured data
You rent the platform; leaving usually means rebuilding
Your code and content, on hosting in your name
A professional does it with you

sections.title: When a builder is the right choice

items.title: You have almost no budget
items.text: A builder gets you online for the price of a subscription. That is better than no website.

items.title: You need a page this week
items.text: For a simple page with your details, a template is fast.

items.title: You are testing an idea
items.text: Prove the idea first, then build properly once it works.

items.title: You want to run a small shop yourself
items.text: Shopify is a strong choice if you want to manage everything yourself and the monthly fee plus transaction costs suit you.

sections.title: When to hire a web designer

items.title: The website has to win customers
items.text: Not just exist, but turn visitors into calls, enquiries and orders.

items.title: Buyers compare you with competitors
items.text: Exporters, manufacturers and service firms are judged on their website before the first call.

items.title: You need to be found on Google
items.text: Ranking in your city or industry needs control over speed, structure and content.

items.title: A template cannot do what you need
items.text: Product catalogues, booking, customer portals or anything specific to how you work.

items.title: You have outgrown your builder
items.text: Slow pages, rising subscriptions, or a design that no longer fits the business.

sections.title: The middle path
body: Plenty of good businesses start on a builder and move to a custom website once they grow. If your site is on Wix, Squarespace or WordPress today, a redesign can move your content across and keep your Google rankings with proper redirects.
links: What decides the cost of a website

faqs.q: What is the best website maker in India?
faqs.a: For a do-it-yourself site, the common choices are Wix, Hostinger Website Builder and Squarespace, and Shopify for online stores. For a business that needs to stand out, rank and turn visitors into customers, a custom website built by a web designer is usually the better long-term investment.

faqs.q: Is Wix good for SEO?
faqs.a: Wix covers the SEO basics, and Wix sites can rank. The limits are page weight and control over how pages are built, which matter more in competitive searches.

faqs.q: Can you move my website from Wix or WordPress?
faqs.a: Yes. The content is moved across, old addresses are redirected so rankings are kept, and the new site is built to be faster.

faqs.q: Is a custom website more expensive than a builder?
faqs.a: It costs more to start, because it is built for you. Builders charge a subscription every month for as long as the site is online, plus apps and transaction fees, so over a few years the gap is often smaller than it looks.

faqs.q: Can I edit a custom website myself?
faqs.a: Yes, where that is part of the brief. Content that changes often gets an admin panel; content that changes twice a year does not need one.

cta: Not sure which you need? Tell me about the business and I will tell you honestly.
